items.title: Minimal primes of the support, of the associated primes and of a filtration all agree
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition states that for a finite module over a Noetherian ring three sets of primes coincide: the minimal primes in the support, the minimal primes among the associated primes, and the minimal primes occurring in any filtration with cyclic prime quotients (statement lines 15404-15416). The proof does not use primary decomposition: it reads the first and third sets off a filtration, then relates associated primes to the support by annihilator arguments and compares the minimal elements of the two sets (proof lines 15418-15448). Transferring minimality between the two descriptions is the step that closes the comparison. H2.
